UPDATE chat_moderation_jobs
            SET phase = 3,
                status = 3,
                deleted_messages = $4,
                deleted_reactions = $5,
                locked_by = NULL,
                locked_at = NULL,
                last_error = NULL,
                completed_at = NOW(),
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1 AND locked_by = $2 AND lock_version = $3 AND status = 2
